title.zh-CN: 主动更新、今日回顾与更顺畅的日常操作
title.en: Proactive updates, daily review, and smoother everyday actions

items.zh-CN: 新版本会通过非阻塞卡片提示，可立即更新、24 小时后提醒或仅跳过当前版本，并在安装后直接重启。
items.en: New releases now appear in a non-blocking card with options to update now, remind in 24 hours, or skip only that version, followed by an in-app restart.

items.zh-CN: 日常模式新增“今日回顾”，汇总当天事件、恢复、网络异常与操作结果，并只在证据充分时描述观察到的变化。
items.en: Everyday mode gains a Today review that summarizes incidents, recoveries, network events, and action results while reporting observed changes only when evidence is sufficient.

items.zh-CN: Robin 现在可以双击或通过菜单打开主窗口，自动休眠建议中的阻止应用也可直接点击查看对应进程。
items.en: Robin can now open the main window by double-click or menu, and apps blocking automatic sleep can be opened directly in the process view.

items.zh-CN: 专业模式左上角品牌和文件位置等操作文案更加清晰，减少难懂的技术表达。
items.en: Professional-mode branding and file-location actions now use clearer, less technical wording.
